title: Listen, Loud.
sub:
We started off by playing covers to find our sound. Still not so sure where we're headed, but as the sound becomes clearer, we bless you with original Fairybutcher songs. Stay tuned.

In our Soundgallery you'll find our 'Bandbuddyday' videos. We’re showcasing our members’ hobbies so that we can get to know each other better. The first round focuses on sporting hobbies, and cultural hobbies will be next.
